01, Executive Summary

Executive Summary

We are pleased to present The Riverline at The 78, a newly delivered 200-unit Class A high-rise located within Related Midwest's fully built-out The 78, Chicago's premier riverfront mixed-use district on the Near South Side. Completed in 2025, The Riverline offers institutional-quality construction, luxury finishes, and an extensive amenity package designed to attract renters seeking a modern urban lifestyle steps from the Loop.

Each studio through three-bedroom layout comes with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, floor-to-ceiling windows, full-size in-unit laundry, and a private balcony with river and skyline views. 20% of the building's 200 residences are income-restricted under the city's affordable housing requirements, consistent with The 78's broader commitment to mixed-income housing. The amenities are similarly well-appointed, anchored by a rooftop saltwater pool and sky lounge alongside a fitness studio, co-working space with private pods, a pet spa and dog run, a fire pit terrace, and 132 structured parking spaces with EV charging.

Positioned along The 78's half-mile riverwalk, The Riverline offers immediate access to the Loop, Chicago Fire FC's 22,000-seat stadium, and the Red Line's 15th Street infill station, all now fully open and operating as anchors of the completed district. The property is surrounded by a diverse mix of dining, retail, and green space, with convenient access to major Near South Side and downtown employment centers, McCormick Place, and Chinatown.

New ownership has the opportunity to acquire one of the newest and highest-quality multifamily assets delivered within The 78. With limited direct Class A competition along the riverwalk, continued build-out throughout the broader district, and strong renter demand for luxury housing near the Loop, The Riverline is ideally positioned to capitalize on sustained occupancy and long-term rent growth. The property's irreplaceable riverfront location, institutional-quality construction, and best-in-market amenity offering create a compelling core investment opportunity within one of Chicago's most closely watched new neighborhoods.

02, Location

Location

SITE MAP, NEAR SOUTH SIDE — CLICK TO OPEN IN GOOGLE MAPS

The Near South Side community area counts roughly 29,000 residents with a median household income near $125,000 and a median age of 35. A young, high-income base consistent with strong lease-up velocity for new Class A product.

Nearby: The Loop (≈0.5 mi), McCormick Place convention campus, Chinatown, Roosevelt Rd retail corridor, DePaul and Columbia College campuses, I-90/94 via Roosevelt Rd, Metra and CTA Red/Green Line access, and the planned Red Line 15th Street infill station a short walk from the building's front door.
